entries.title: The twelve branches
entries.content: The twelve earthly branches split the day into twelve two-hour blocks and the year into twelve months. Branches are read as the 'earth' or practical layer of a chart.
entries.source: Korea Times Gunghap 3; Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Combinations and clashes
entries.content: Branches can 'combine' or 'clash'. Readers use these to talk about change, tension and harmony.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Hidden stems
entries.content: Each branch is said to hold 'hidden stems', secondary elements under the surface. They add detail to how a chart is read.
entries.source: Korea Times Gunghap 3; BaZi hour pillar guide
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
